notes.title: Release notes
notes.content:
Draft release notes for the voice workflow launch.

  • Highlight listen & copy
  • Ship voice workflow first

meetings.title: Product planning
meetings.minutes: Reviewed feedback and agreed on priorities.

meetings.title: Weekly review
meetings.minutes: Discussed shipping timeline and open tasks.
meetings.decisions: Keep focus on documentation and voice flow.

thoughts.title: Voice-first capture
thoughts.content: What if capturing notes started with voice and then organised itself into meetings and tasks?

thoughts.title: Calmer mornings
thoughts.content: Start each day with a 5-minute recap of open tasks and one memory to revisit.

memories.title: First team offsite
memories.content: We sketched the Bi-Polar concept on sticky notes under a tree.

memories.title: Voice demo day
memories.content: The room went quiet when the assistant read notes aloud for the first time.

memories.title: Launch checklist habit
memories.content: Started keeping a shared MOM template before every release planning session.

memories.title: Rainy desk session
memories.content: Captured three ideas in one sitting: backup cadence, server renewal, and calmer UI.
